name: sessiondeck-bridge
description: Invisible companion that aggregates SessionDeck host snapshots on the local desktop so one panel can show every open host. No UI, no network, no configuration.

scripts.package: bun run build && cp ../CHANGELOG.md CHANGELOG.md && mkdir -p ../dist-vsix && bunx @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out ../dist-vsix/
